summary: Verstappen arrives at Mexico City under a cloud of controversy after a practice collision with Lawson, threatening to derail his championship momentum as grid penalties loom. McLaren's Antonelli fights illness while standing on the precipice of his maiden world title, setting up a high-stakes showdown against a wounded championship leader. A victory here could seal Antonelli's crown or hand Verstappen a crucial lifeline, making this weekend potentially decisive in determining whether the lead changes hands for good.
